acceptance_criteria: scripts/dev/design_precheck.py: deterministic gate verifying single capability, no duplicate controls, review_scope parity, rollback consistency, and no dangling references before LLM review
config/item-tiers.json and tier integration: items declare tier 1 (tooling), tier 2 (feature), tier 3 (security/data) with tier-aware gate thresholds and tier-1 Gate 1.5 bypass
scripts/dev/architect_review.py and gate1_check.py: enforce structured finding schema (id, sig, category, consequence) and structured dispositions naming changed file, test, and command
scripts/dev/gate1_check.py: stop-and-split rule halts Gate 1 approval if more than 2 MAJOR findings are reported in a full review, requiring HIL scope reduction
scripts/dev/recurring_findings_check.py: deterministic precheck gate machine-checking high-recurrence findings from review-findings.json to drive findings per review down
All new scripts are compiled, covered by docstrings, wired into precheck or lifecycle documentation, and run with PF_BACKLOG_DB=on
